==Problem==
How many three-digit numbers are divisible by 13?

<imath> \textbf{(A)}\ 7\qquad\textbf{(B)}\ 67\qquad\textbf{(C)}\ 69\qquad\textbf{(D)}\ 76\qquad\textbf{(E)}\ 77</imath>


==Solution 1==
Let <imath>k</imath> be any positive integer so that <imath>13k</imath> is a multiple of <imath>13</imath>. For the smallest three-digit number, <imath>13k>100</imath> and <imath>k>\frac{100}{13} \approx 7.7</imath>. For the greatest three-digit number, <imath>13k<999</imath> and <imath>k<\frac{999}{13} \approx 76.8</imath>. The number <imath>k</imath> can range from <imath>8</imath> to <imath>76</imath> so there are <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(C)}\ 69}</imath> three-digit numbers.


==Solution 2==
3 digits number start from 100 and ends at 999.
1 to 100 total multiple of <imath>13 =\frac{100}{13}</imath> 

1 to 999 total multple of <imath>13 =\frac{999}{13}</imath> 

Hence <imath>\frac{999}{13}-\frac{100}{13}</imath>
=76-7
=69


~KENJAKURA
